headline: Ukraine's drone attacks hit taxi drivers in Istanbul - Sözcü Newspaper
summary: A Ukrainian drone attack on the data center of Russian technology company Yandex halted operations. Taxi drivers in Turkey using Yandex Go were unable to receive payments.
why: Yandex is a Russian technology group whose ride-hailing app is used by drivers in several countries, so service outages affect payments and operations there.
